Bash(/tmp/write-deck-diff-fixed.ps1 << 'PSEOF'
$filePath = 'C:\\Users\\chris\\Documents\\Desk\\Am arbeiten\\Neuer Ordner\\src\\deckbuilder\\deck-diff-panel.ts'

# Read the file that was written \(which has double-encoded UTF-8\)
$bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes\($filePath\)

# Decode as UTF-8 to get the \(incorrectly double-encoded\) string
$text = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString\($bytes\)

# Now we need to fix the double-encoding. The text has chars like U+00E2, U+20AC, U+201D
# where it should have U+2014 \(em-dash\). But it's simpler to just reconstruct.
# Actually, let's read the raw bytes as Windows-1252 \(Latin1\) to recover the original UTF-8 bytes
$latin1 = [System.Text.Encoding]::GetEncoding\(28591\)
$originalBytes = $latin1.GetBytes\($text\)

# Now decode those bytes as UTF-8
$correctText = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString\($originalBytes\)

# Write back as UTF-8 no BOM
$utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding\($false\)
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText\($filePath, $correctText, $utf8NoBom\)

# Verify
$verifyBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes\($filePath\)
Write-Host \("File rewritten. Size: {0} bytes" -f $verifyBytes.Length\)
# Check the em-dash area
for \($i = 18; $i -le 28; $i++\) {
    Write-Host \("Byte {0}: 0x{1:X2}" -f $i, $verifyBytes[$i]\)
}
PSEOF)

$filePath = 'C:\\Users\\chris\\Documents\\Desk\\Am arbeiten\\Neuer Ordner\\src\\deckbuilder\\deck-diff-panel.ts'
$content = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText\($filePath, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8\)

    @\('computeDiff export', $content.Contains\('export function computeDiff'\)\)
    @\('showDiffPanel export', $content.Contains\('export function showDiffPanel'\)\)
    @\('hideDiffPanel export', $content.Contains\('export function hideDiffPanel'\)\)
    @\('toggleDiffPanel export', $content.Contains\('export function toggleDiffPanel'\)\)
    @\('isDiffPanelOpen export', $content.Contains\('export function isDiffPanelOpen'\)\)
    @\('renderPanel function', $content.Contains\('function renderPanel'\)\)
    @\('buildCardMap function', $content.Contains\('function buildCardMap'\)\)
    @\('DiffCardEntry interface', $content.Contains\('export interface DiffCardEntry'\)\)
    @\('DeckDiffResult interface', $content.Contains\('export interface DeckDiffResult'\)\)
    @\('BoardCards interface', $content.Contains\('interface BoardCards'\)\)

    @\('arrow symbol', $content.Contains\([char]0x2192\)\)  # right arrow

\)
